Here is the complete mapping. `DashboardController` directly depends on **7 service interfaces**, each with one concrete implementation:

---

### Controller
| Class | File |
|-------|------|
| `DashboardController` | `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/controller/DashboardController.java` |

---

### Service Interfaces → Concrete Implementations

| Interface | Interface File | Implementation Class | Implementation File |
|-----------|---------------|---------------------|---------------------|
| `TbDashboardService` | `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/entitiy/dashboard/TbDashboardService.java` | `DefaultTbDashboardService` | `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/entitiy/dashboard/DefaultTbDashboardService.java` |
| `DashboardService` | `common/dao-api/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/dashboard/DashboardService.java` | `DashboardServiceImpl` | `dao/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/dashboard/DashboardServiceImpl.java` |
| `TenantService` | `common/dao-api/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/tenant/TenantService.java` | `TenantServiceImpl` | `dao/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/tenant/TenantServiceImpl.java` |
| `UserService` | `common/dao-api/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/user/UserService.java` | `UserServiceImpl` | `dao/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/user/UserServiceImpl.java` |
| `CustomerService` | `common/dao-api/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/customer/CustomerService.java` | `CustomerServiceImpl` | `dao/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/customer/CustomerServiceImpl.java` |
| `AccessControlService` | `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/security/permission/AccessControlService.java` | `DefaultAccessControlService` | `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/security/permission/DefaultAccessControlService.java` |
| `TbResourceService` | `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/resource/TbResourceService.java` | `DefaultTbResourceService` | `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/resource/DefaultTbResourceService.java` |

---

**Notes:**
- The two "application-layer" services (`TbDashboardService`, `TbResourceService`, `AccessControlService`) live in the `application` module alongside the controller.
- The four "DAO-layer" services (`DashboardService`, `TenantService`, `UserService`, `CustomerService`) are defined as interfaces in `common/dao-api` and implemented in the `dao` module.
- Each interface has exactly one concrete implementation class.
